ModMetaData.name: KanbanStockpile-Refilled
ModMetaData.author: eiennohito
ModMetaData.description:
Stack limits and refill thresholds for stockpiles, shelves and Adaptive Storage.
Open the Storage tab: • Max similar limits stacks of each item; Off leaves hauling unchanged. • Refill Until sets a smaller stack size when Max similar is 1; Max Stack uses the item's usual maximum. • Refill From starts refilling at or below the chosen percentage; 100% allows normal top-ups.
Pawns continue an active refill above the threshold and may skip small final top-ups. Incoming deliveries count toward the limit. Pick Up And Haul, Continued by Zzyxzz and Reworked retain inventory batching.
Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. Enable in place of either earlier KanbanStockpile version; saved settings carry over. Multiplayer is not supported.
Details, credits and source: https://github.com/eiennohito/rimworld-kanbanstockpile-refilled
